events.title: Introduction to Sewing
events.description: Presented by Tegan Bienke, Learn the basic sewing skills anyone needs to get started with any cotton creation.

events.title: The World of RC Helicopters
events.description: Presented by Karl Rickards & Dennis Beilby. #Mad4Heli #SoxosAustralia #QRCHA, Find out how this very inclusive and accessible hobby gives you control of all 3 dimensions! Radio Controlled Helicopters are unlike any RC hobby as it combines not only the amazing thrill of flight but combines the skill set you will develop in fundamental engineering concepts. With a vibrant community eager to help you along it’s a great social network of passionate aeromodellers where no runway is required.

events.title: Click ’n’ Stick
events.description: Presented by Ty Hanson, Mission 01: Take a photo of Eevee and Psyduck together. Optional: Scare Psyduck from his pond. In this panel, I show you how I make a "Pokemon Snap" themed diorama. From priming & painting, to resin pours and misguided mis-steps - this workshop will show you the processes involved with making an entry for the GHMX!

events.title: Model Kit Speed Building
events.description: Hosted by GhMX, How fast can you build a model kit? 4 builders competing live on stage with the exact same kit and 25mins to complete it! Judges will choose 1 winner. Register your spot at the IPMS QLD stand

events.title: An Introduction to Figure Painting
events.description: Presented by Graham McNamara - Riverside Scale Model Club, Let multi-award winner and one of Australia's best figure painters introduce you to the world of figure painting as he runs through the basic tecniques and tools required for building and painting figures of all sizes and subjects.

events.title: Building the World of Gerry Anderson

events.title: Keeping It Simple Cosplay

events.title: Publishing Your Own Writing
events.description: Presented by Ty Hansen, Millennium Exile author, Ty Hanson explains the "behind the scenes" of creating, writing and managing a creative IP.

events.title: Aircraft Recognition Competition
